decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of small, efficient creatures. It utilizes cards like Luminarch Aspirant, Skyclave Apparition, and Solitude to control the board and remove threats. Stoneforge Mystic and Aether Vial provide equipment and creature tutoring, while Ephemerate and Flickerwisp offer additional value by blinking creatures. The deck also includes support cards like Giver of Runes and Esper Sentinel to protect your creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the strategy is to maintain board presence and tempo, applying constant pressure to win the game quickly.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and aggressive creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Murktide Regent, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. It also relies on efficient spells like Lightning Bolt, Counterspell, and Unholy Heat to control the board and protect its creatures. Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help with card selection and generating card advantage. The mana base is optimized for casting spells quickly and efficiently, allowing the deck to apply constant pressure on the opponent.

This deck focuses on aggressively disrupting the opponent's hand and board with cards like Grief and Thoughtseize, while also presenting threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer to pressure the opponent. The deck also utilizes cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Feign Death to create additional value and tempo advantage. Removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt help control the board, while cards like Undying Evil provide resilience and recursion for threats. The inclusion of Blood Moon can also disrupt opponents relying on nonbasic lands, giving the deck an edge in certain matchups.

The key concept of this deck is to aggressively deal damage to the opponent as quickly as possible. This is achieved through a combination of low-cost creatures, such as Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, and direct damage spells, including Lightning Bolt, Boros Charm, and Lava Spike. The deck also utilizes burn spells like Skullcrack and Searing Blaze to control the board and prevent the opponent from stabilizing. Additionally, there are cards like Roiling Vortex to disrupt the opponent's game plan and cards like Arid Mesa and Sunbaked Canyon to ensure consistent mana sources.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana and using cascade spells like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to cheat out powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Crashing Footfalls. It also includes disruptive spells like Force of Negation and Mystical Dispute to protect your board and control the game. The goal is to overwhelm your opponent with fast, powerful plays and maintain tempo throughout the game. The combination of aggression and disruptive elements makes this deck a force to be reckoned with in the Modern format.

The deck focuses on milling the opponent's library by playing cards that force them to draw, such as Archive Trap and Fractured Sanity. It also uses creatures like Hedron Crab and Ruin Crab to mill cards whenever lands enter the battlefield. The deck includes interaction like Fatal Push and Drown in the Loch to deal with threats, and Surgical Extraction to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also has card draw spells like Visions of Beyond to dig for combo pieces. Jace, the Perfected Mind can provide additional card advantage, while Tasha's Hideous Laughter can exile the opponent's graveyard.

This deck utilizes the powerful synergy between Underworld Breach, Grinding Station, and various cheap artifacts and creatures to create a combo that allows the player to quickly mill through their deck and win the game with Thassa's Oracle. Using cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mox Amber to generate mana and keep the combo going, the deck aims to disrupt opponents with disruptive spells like Teferi, Time Raveler and Prismatic Ending while assembling its win condition. The overall strategy is to control the game until the combo can be assembled for a quick and unexpected victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing various creatures with sacrifice abilities to generate value and disrupt opponents. By tutoring for specific creatures using cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, the deck can quickly assemble key pieces for combos or control the board. Yawgmoth, Thran Physician serves as a powerful engine for the deck, while cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Blood Artist provide additional win conditions. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue opponents through its toolbox of creatures and versatile combo potential.

Utilizing a combination of spells and creatures, this deck focuses on quickly assembling the necessary pieces to pull off a devastating combo that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. The key strategy involves using cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Indomitable Creativity to create powerful synergies with cards like Archon of Cruelty and Leyline Binding. With a mix of control elements like Spell Pierce and removal spells like Lightning Bolt, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while setting up its own win condition through creative and unexpected plays.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer, backed up by disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Terminate. It also utilizes graveyard interaction with cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. The deck aims to quickly pressure the opponent while disrupting their game plan, and has some graveyard recursion and protection spells to ensure its threats stick around. The inclusion of cards like Fury and Feign Death provide additional versatility and options for combat tricks.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying early pressure with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker. The deck utilizes disruptive spells like Grief and Thoughtseize to strip key cards from the opponent's hand, while removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt handle threats on the battlefield. Feign Death and Undying Malice provide recursion and recurring threats, allowing the deck to maintain pressure throughout the game. Blood Moon is included to disrupt opponent's mana base, giving the deck an edge in the mid to late game.

The key concept of this deck is to put pressure on the opponent quickly with a focus on playing low-cost, aggressive creatures like Murktide Regent, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Dragon's Rage Channeler. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Counterspell, Spell Pierce, and Force of Negation to protect its threats and control the tempo of the game. Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration provide card advantage and help set up future plays. The mana base is designed to support the deck's game plan and provide flexibility in casting spells.
